sources.title: Cate README
sources.locator: Install table; What is inside; Shared workspaces and remote access
sources.finding: Infinite-canvas IDE for parallel coding agents. Install: macOS DMG/ZIP arm64+x64, Windows NSIS/ZIP x64, Linux AppImage/DEB/tar.gz x64, plus Homebrew cask. Features: shared live workspaces, agent-aware terminals with running/waiting/finished states, sessions survive restarts with resume, shared prompt queues, usage overview by time/agent/model plus Claude/Codex subscription limits, git worktrees with colored canvas territories, panels on canvas or dock, multi-repo git with side-by-side diffs, ripgrep search, Cmd+K. Share pairs devices by QR/code over LAN or Cate Connect with end-to-end encryption; Availability choices: finish running work, stay available, stop with Cate.

sources.title: Cate architecture
sources.finding: The runtime is the application: one daemon per workspace; clients (desktop Electron+React shell, iPhone SwiftUI shell) render runtime state. Transports: local socket, machine (SSH/WSL command), network (LAN or Cate Connect). Cate Connect passes connection setup and runs a TURN relay; it never sees workspace plaintext. Agent means one provider CLI identity. D3: every client is the same to the runtime; no roles, no per-client permissions. D4: Noise handshake with pinned keys, only known devices; local transport is OS-user protected with a caller token reaching only the api capability. iOS push goes through an APNs target with a notification service extension.

sources.locator: Desktop crash reporting and usage analytics; Cate Connect; Controller; Automatic updates
sources.finding: Controller: 0-AI UG (haftungsbeschraenkt), Stuttgart.
